# Advising errors and warnings

Diagnostics about advice: overriding and introducing members, implementing interfaces, adding initializers, and conflicts between aspects.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0500> | An aspect introduces a member that already exists, and the override strategy doesn't allow it. |
| <xref:lama0502> | An aspect tries to override a base member that is static, non-virtual or sealed. |
| <xref:lama0503> | An introduced member conflicts with an existing member that has a different type or return type. |
| <xref:lama0504> | An introduced member conflicts with an existing member, and only one of them is static. |
| <xref:lama0505> | An aspect introduces an instance member into a static class. |
| <xref:lama0506> | An introduced member has the same name as an existing member of a different kind. |
| <xref:lama0507> | An aspect introduces a member that is both static and virtual into a class or a struct. |
| <xref:lama0508> | An aspect introduces a member that is both static and sealed. |
| <xref:lama0509> | An aspect introduces a member with OverrideStrategy.New, but the target type already declares this member. |
| <xref:lama0511> | An aspect member marked with [InterfaceMember] doesn't have the same type as the interface member it implements. |
| <xref:lama0512> | An aspect implements an interface that the target type already implements, and the strategy is to fail. |
| <xref:lama0513> | An aspect implements a generic interface without specifying its type arguments. |
| <xref:lama0514> | The target type already contains a member with the same signature as an interface member that the aspect implements implicitly. |
| <xref:lama0516> | The override strategy passed to ImplementInterface isn't supported for interfaces. |
| <xref:lama0517> | The template of an interface property doesn't have an accessor required by the interface. |
| <xref:lama0518> | The template of an explicitly implemented interface property has an accessor that the interface property doesn't have. |
| <xref:lama0519> | An implicit interface implementation uses an aspect member that isn't public. |
| <xref:lama0520> | An aspect tries to introduce a parameter into a static constructor. |
| <xref:lama0521> | An aspect introduces a custom attribute that's already present on the declaration. |
| <xref:lama0522> | An aspect introduces a finalizer with an unsupported override strategy. |
| <xref:lama0524> | An aspect can't add an initializer to the copy constructor of a record. |
| <xref:lama0526> | An aspect introduces an indexer that has no parameter. |
| <xref:lama0527> | An aspect introduces a static indexer, which C# doesn't support. |
| <xref:lama0528> | An aspect implementing an interface can't override an existing member of the target type because the member isn't public. |
| <xref:lama0529> | An aspect implementing an interface can't override an inherited member because the member isn't virtual or is sealed. |
| <xref:lama0530> | An aspect introduces a constructor parameter with the name of a parameter that an aspect already introduced. |
| <xref:lama0531> | An aspect introduces a type whose name is already used by a type of the target namespace or type. |
| <xref:lama0532> | An aspect introduces an abstract member into a type that isn't abstract. |
| <xref:lama0533> | An aspect introduces an abstract member with the override strategy Override or New. |
| <xref:lama0534> | An aspect tries to introduce a field into an interface. |
| <xref:lama0535> | An aspect introduces a partial member into a type that isn't partial. |
| <xref:lama0536> | The pull strategy gives no value for a forwarding constructor to pass to the introduced parameter. |
| <xref:lama0540> | An aspect introduces an extension block into a type that isn't a static class. |
| <xref:lama0541> | An aspect introduces an extension block into another extension block. |
| <xref:lama0550> | An aspect adds an initializer to the Initialize method of a non-sealed class, but this method isn't public and virtual. |
| <xref:lama0551> | A base type defines an OnConstructed method, but none of its constructors accepts an InitializationContext. |
| <xref:lama0650> | A template invokes the base implementation of a member on an instance other than this. |
| <xref:lama0651> | A template calls meta.Proceed() while overriding a member that the compiler synthesizes for a record. |
| <xref:lama0699> | The implementation of an overridden constructor or indexer can't be inlined. |
| <xref:lama0700> | An aspect with [Introduce] members is applied to a declaration that isn't a type or a type member. |
| <xref:lama0750> | An aspect with [Introduce] members is applied to an enum, a delegate, or another type that can't receive members. |
| <xref:lama0751> | An interface marked with [InternalImplement] is implemented outside its project (not reported by current versions). |
